title: studio → pipelines: a message to the batch's director
description: From API 1.15. Written by studio's outbox in the transaction that stores the user's chat message (POST /v1/studio/batches/{id}/chat); subject `cmd.pipeline.chat` (stream CMD, the batch's command counter, Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`). pipelines appends it to the director's thread (`<batch_id>:director`) and wakes it; messages that arrive while it thinks are read together on its next wake. A redelivered message (same message_id) is appended once.
